expected_en: At the camp workshop, Michael shakes a lantern that will not light. Joseph fetches fresh batteries while Gracie spreads yellow fabric across their exhibition table. Their assignment is to explain the Holy Spirit. Michael suggests placing the lantern beside a sign saying God’s power.

Rosie pauses with her purple Bible open. Electricity can power a lamp, but can it teach, love, or be lied to? Explorer, help the team investigate before they build a display that teaches the wrong idea.

Рози задумалась над открытой фиолетовой Библией. Электричество зажигает лампу, но может ли оно учить, любить? Можно ли ему солгать? Исследователь, помоги разобраться, прежде чем выставка начнёт учить неверному.

Then they examine Acts 5:3–4. Peter describes lying to the Holy Spirit as lying to God. The passage treats the Spirit as divine and personal, not as an object people can operate.

expected_en: Gracie removes the battery sign. She worries that she felt nothing special during yesterday’s prayer. Rosie points back to Jesus’ promise: their confidence belongs in what he says, not in measuring goosebumps. The Holy Spirit helps God’s people know truth and follow Jesus even on ordinary afternoons.
At that moment Michael discovers he packed the wrong exhibition cards. He almost blames Joseph. Instead, he asks God for help, tells the truth, and starts making replacement cards with the others.

Рози возвращается к обещанию Иисуса: доверять нужно Его словам, а не измерять мурашки. Святой Дух помогает Божьему народу знать истину и следовать за Иисусом даже в обычный день.

expected_en: The lantern finally shines above the table, lighting their reading without pretending to explain God. Their new cards describe what the Bible says the Spirit does. Gracie adds an invitation to ask questions, and Michael carries the discarded sign to the recycling box.

You help arrange the final cards. One God is Father, Son, and Holy Spirit; the Spirit is not a smaller god or Jesus wearing a different costume. The explorers leave asking for help to obey, not searching for a stronger spiritual battery.

expected_en: Rosie sits nearby instead of giving a victory speech. Together they read Philippians 2:12–13. God works in his people, shaping both their desire and their action. Joseph is not abandoned to change himself by willpower, and he is not invited to sit still while others suffer his angry words.
In Galatians 5 they find the Spirit’s fruit, including patience and kindness. These qualities grow from life with God. They are not entrance tickets that purchase his love.

expected_en: The repaired bridge holds a little wooden cart. Joseph lets Michael roll it across first. He cannot promise that tomorrow will contain no angry thoughts, but he can describe a new direction: ask for help, speak honestly, and practice kindness when frustration returns.

Explorer, notice what changed besides the bridge. Joseph welcomed people back into the work. The Spirit’s help does not make our choices unnecessary; it enables us to take them differently. Their afternoon ends with thanks, not a chart ranking whose fruit grew fastest.

title.en: A visitor asks why it matters

expected_en: A visitor asks what this belief changes on Monday. Gracie places their response card beside the Bible: because Jesus lives, they can trust him, seek forgiveness, and bring hope and practical care to hurting people. She remembers the chair their friends carried when she was grieving.

The visitor then asks a question Joseph cannot answer. He writes it down, checks that he understood it, and offers to explore it with a trusted adult. He does not invent an answer to protect the exhibition’s reputation.
expected_ru: Гость спрашивает, что эта вера меняет в понедельник. Грейси кладёт карточку ответа рядом с Библией: Иисус жив, поэтому они могут доверять Ему, искать прощения и нести надежду и помощь людям в боли. Она вспоминает стул, который друзья несли в день её скорби.
Затем гость задаёт вопрос, на который Джозеф не знает ответа. Он записывает его, уточняет смысл и предлагает исследовать со взрослым. Он не выдумывает ответ ради репутации выставки.

expected_en: Before packing up, each explorer names one conviction, one next action, and one question still open. Michael will correct an exaggerated claim. Rosie will read with a younger friend who wants help. Gracie will keep making room for people who need quiet company.

Explorer, leave your own question card on the table. This journey ends with an invitation, not a certificate declaring that every mystery is solved. Following Jesus joins truthful belief, thoughtful reasons, and practiced love. Tomorrow offers another chance to listen, learn, and take the next faithful step.
expected_ru: Перед уборкой каждый называет убеждение, следующий поступок и открытый вопрос. Майкл исправит преувеличенное сообщение. Рози почитает с младшим другом, который попросил помощи. Грейси продолжит находить место для тех, кому нужна тихая компания.

Исследователь, оставь на столе свою карточку вопроса. Путешествие завершается приглашением, а не дипломом о разгадке всех тайн. Следование Иисусу соединяет истинную веру, продуманные основания и любовь на деле. Завтра снова можно слушать, учиться и делать следующий верный шаг.
